entries.zh: （书的）一页脱落、掉页；书叶掉下来
entries.en: (of a book) for a leaf/page to come loose and fall out
entries.notes: H栏「快」与M音ya不合（当为「葉/頁」），释义据L「caerse la falda del libro」+M「lo ya」互证。

entries.zh: 财物损失；东西毁坏（失落）
entries.en: loss or ruin of a thing; damaged or lost property
entries.notes: H「墜」与M「hüy」（hūi，殆「毀」）不合，以L「pérdida de cosa」为准。

entries.en: ruined; come to nothing, broken down (of fortune/family)

entries.zh: 浪（浪荡放肆；游荡无度之人）
entries.en: a dissolute, roving man; vagrant/prodigal

entries.zh: 鹧鸪（西语 perdiz 所指禽名）
entries.en: partridge
entries.notes: H「鶊」与M音chiâ不合，疑为「鷓」之误读；禽名义据L定。

entries.en: partridge
entries.notes: H「鶯鴣」当为「鷓鴣」，M次音节cuí存疑；据L「(perdiz)」定禽名。

entries.en: to pardon, forgive; to excuse
entries.notes: R栏残，仅存「nio chiūn. chiū fàng.」，未碍释义。

entries.en: to forgive, pardon; forbearance
entries.notes: M栏标[残]仅存「ſû」（sù），义据「恕」自明。

entries.en: to pity, relieve; to pardon with compassion
to tolerate, bear with; to forgive/allow
to pardon, forgive; to show leniency
entries.notes: M栏杂有西语「ǎiudar」（殆ayudar）字样，视为旁注。

entries.en: to remit, excuse; to exempt/pardon
to be magnanimous, forgiving; to excuse
to bear with, put up with; to yield
entries.notes: 单字「将」配perdonar，殆取「将就」义，系推断。

entries.en: to pardon, absolve; amnesty
to forgive, spare; to let off

entries.zh: 化解怨恨、宽解宿仇（不记前嫌）
entries.en: to let a grudge/resentment go; to forgive a grievance
entries.notes: H「憾」（怨恨义）与M音kài（疑「解」）不合，取宽解宿怨义。

entries.zh: 宽免部分债款（抹账、折让欠款）
entries.en: to forgive/remit part of a debt; to write off a portion owed
entries.notes: H「助」与M「chan choui」难以对证，据L「perdonar parte de la deuda」定夺。

entries.zh: 让价、抹掉一点价钱（减价折让）
entries.en: to knock something off the price; to give a small discount
entries.notes: M「sit. Soa la」未能确证汉字，据L「perdonar algo del precio」定释义；H「息」或取让息义。

entries.zh: 让手（松手退让、让步息争）
entries.en: to yield, give way; to let go and desist
entries.notes: M标[残]但H「让手」+M「niu chiū」互证一致。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 仅余西语括注「(per donar)」（殆perdonar之重复），汉字、闽南、官话三栏皆空。
